BiblicalUsage: This word for disease stands in one verse only, and only in the older Greek text behind the King James Version: the man at the pool is made whole of whatsoever disease he had. The newer Greek text does not carry that verse at all, so the word's only home is the disputed verse itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the disputed verse still tells the truth: whatever disease held the man, the pool could not heal him — only Christ could.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
